clips.title: The story
paras: Scouts, assassins, and underworld operatives gather in the Rogues' Quarter, in the Undercity's southeastern wing. Craftsmen there support their covert work.

Survivors skilled in stealth gather in the Rogues' Quarter, deep in the Undercity's southeastern wing. Many served the Kingdom of Lordaeron in life as thieves, cutpurses, or silent blades. In death, they use their skills with stealth, poisons, and misdirection to defend the fledgling nation from the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade. Operatives sharpen daggers, brew toxins, and hone clandestine skills in this covert haven.

Specialized trades in the Rogues' Quarter support undercover survival. Artisans teach travelers leatherworking and skinning, turning raw hides into light, silent armor. Tinkers work at engineering benches, while field medics and apothecaries teach first aid. Poison vendors stationed nearby supply lethal reagents for covert work.
